content: Many of the studies are deemed ineligible due to their study design, as indicated repeatedly in the text. The references cover topics such as drug price regulation, cost-sharing mechanisms, generic drug policies, biosimilar adoption, and the impact of pricing systems like reference pricing on healthcare expenditures and patient access. These studies span a wide range of geographical regions, including Europe, Asia, North America, and Australia, and address both high-income and low-to-middle-income country contexts.
